reason: The official Planning Data API point-query route is materially different from the prior licensed HM Land Registry National Polygon Service route: it is public/no-login and is designed to return entities whose geometry covers a supplied coordinate. Forge Cottage has an authoritative Planning Data outline and point, but the custom title-boundary API request for that exact point is not accessible through this transport. Because no target-specific API response was retrieved, no title-boundary polygon is promoted to canonical parcel geometry and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
